# What to charge per charter trip, once weather cancellations are counted

> Free pricing calculator for fishing charter captains: fuel, deckhand, fixed costs, weather cancellations and the profit you want become a break-even price, a target price per trip and per angler. Private, runs in your browser.

Free to use and source available (FSL-1.1-MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.

- [The tool](https://duncan-haywood.github.io/oss-monorepo/fishing-charter-trip-pricing-calculator/)
